inverter.name: Hybrid solar inverter
inverter.alt: A white wall-mounted solar inverter with a small screen
inverter.intro: One wall unit that brings solar panels, a battery bank and the grid together, and runs the whole house on pure sine wave power.

points.title: Solar first
points.line: Two MPPT inputs take up to 5,500 W of panels each and charge a 48 V lithium or lead-acid battery bank.

points.title: No break in a power cut
points.line: When the grid drops it switches to battery in about 10 ms, so the house keeps running.

points.title: Grid or generator charging
points.line: It can also charge from mains or a generator, on a timer set to the hours you choose.

points.title: Grows with the house
points.line: Up to six units run in parallel, for more power or three-phase output.

inverter.note: Wiring to your panel and batteries should be done by a licensed electrician. Jontai Energy does not install.
inverter.source: Figures from the Namkoo SPI series datasheet. Ask what is on the shelf.

solar-ac.name: Hybrid solar air conditioner
solar-ac.alt: A white indoor air conditioning unit and its grey outdoor unit
solar-ac.intro: A split air conditioner that runs straight off solar panels during the day and mixes in grid power only when it needs to. No battery and no separate inverter.

figures.label: solar while the sun is out

points.title: Panels plug straight in
points.line: A built-in MPPT takes 22 to 45 V DC from the panels through MC4 connectors.

points.title: Grid only when needed
points.line: When the panels cannot keep up, it mixes in 220 V mains on its own.

points.title: Built for the coast
points.line: A zinc-coated, anticorrosion casing for homes near the sea.

points.title: Back on after a power cut
points.line: It restarts by itself when the power returns.

solar-ac.note: The manufacturer requires installation by a skilled HVAC technician. Jontai Energy does not install.
solar-ac.source: Figures from the ACDC hybrid solar AC brochure. Ask which sizes are in stock.

power-station.name: Portable power station
power-station.alt: A grey portable power station with a screen and four sockets
power-station.intro: A quiet battery you can carry, with household sockets on the front. Keep the fridge, fans and phones running through an outage, then recharge it from the wall or a solar panel.

points.title: A socket for everything
points.line: Four 220 V AC sockets (110 V optional), four USB, two USB-C, a car socket and two DC ports.

points.title: A battery that lasts
points.line: LiFePO4 cells rated for 3,000 charge cycles or more.

points.title: Light when it is dark
points.line: A built-in LED lamp with three brightness levels and an alarm light.

points.title: Protected
points.line: Guards against overcharge, over-discharge, short circuits, overcurrent, and high or low temperature.

power-station.source: Figures from the Namkoo 3000W spec sheet. Other models differ.
